title: Live worksite
hint: Every fragment of the task, the machine computing it and how far along it is, live. In the endgame, a free machine doubles a fragment that lags behind: the first result wins, the other computation stops.
unavailable: The worksite cannot be read right now: trying again in a few seconds.
about_title: Estimate: the time elapsed, compared with the usual duration of a fragment of this task ({time}).
doubled_title: Endgame: a free machine also computes this lagging fragment. The first result wins; the other computation stops, without counting against its machine.
beaten_title: Endgame: this computation lost the race and stopped, without counting against its machine.
places_title: Places announced {ago}: how many fragments this machine can compute at once, and how many are taken.
places_here_title: Places of this machine: how many fragments it can compute at once, and how many are taken.
